summary: Intelligent Bio Solutions Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a private placement of common stock and warrants to a single institutional investor. The company sold Pre-Funded Warrants (in lieu of 2,036,659 common shares) plus series N-1 and N-2 warrants, with a combined purchase price of $2.455 per unit. Gross proceeds approximated $5.0 million. The N-1 warrants are callable after FDA 510(k) clearance; N-2 warrants exercise pending shareholder approval; exercise price is $2.33. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special-situation event.
